PMID 35977808 - Xu, 2022, Loss-of-function variants in SAT1 cause X-linked childhood-onset systemic lupus erythematosus.

I verified this as the primary disease-defining paper for SLEB19 / SAT1-related systemic lupus erythematosus. I did not find any additional PubMed-indexed patient case reports or cohorts specifically establishing this disease beyond this report; the other SAT1 lupus hit was a review, not a primary patient paper.
